episodes.177991: Strong thunderstorms ahead of a cold front moved through the area with a few measured gusts in excess of 34 knots as well as a waterspout.
episodes.178009: A strong cold front moved through the region during the afternoon hours of March 17th.  A squall line preceded the front, resulting in a few instances of trees and power lines down across the tri-state area.  In addition, a few tornadoes occurred across the Florida panhandle.  Fortunately, these tornadoes impacted forested areas and no structures.
episodes.178010: A strong cold front moved through the region during the afternoon hours of March 17th.  A squall line preceded the front, resulting in a few instances of trees and power lines down across the tri-state area and some roof damage in Sylvester.  In addition, a few tornadoes occurred across the Florida panhandle.  Fortunately, these tornadoes impacted forested areas and no structures.
episodes.178979: A mix of runoff from the storm two days earlier, melting snow, and reservoir releases caused flooding in the Owens Valley.

events.narrative: A report of roof damage was received from Sylvester as severe storms moved through the area with gusty winds.

events.county: Coastal Waters From Oklaloosa-Walton County Line To Mexico Beach Out 20 Nm
events.narrative: The public reported a waterspout moving ashore near Grayton Beach.

A well defined TDS appeared just inland from the coast in the Grayton Beach State Park area.  Pictures of minor tree damage were received.  This tornado was very brief and rated EF0 with the tree damage.  No structures were impacted.

A tornado touched down in a rural, forested area of Bay county near the Panama City airport.  The tornado narrowly missed the airport structures, and no other damage was reported.  A well defined TDS was present on dual-pol radar due to tree damage.
